stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: Can the computer check the prices?
stations.note: After a quote went badly wrong.

stations.title: Sefton's notes
stations.text: The right prices, written as tests.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Hesper wants every price checked after every change.
Sefton wrote the right prices down as tests, but nothing runs them.
You write the runner that saves and runs them, in three tasks.
Now the wrong bulk price for 250 cards is caught and shown.
Same notes, same prices, and a computer that checks them all.
